item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect low temperatures from the lower thirties to the upper thirties under mostly cloudy to overcast skies, with only a slight chance of rain showers early and most areas staying dry. Tomorrow brings high temperatures from the upper forties to the lower fifties with mostly cloudy skies and a chance of rain showers developing by midday, especially likely in the Champlain Valley and Essex County, but rainfall amounts will be light. Tomorrow night, lows dip into the lower thirties with lingering mostly cloudy skies and scattered rain showers, mainly early in the night.
